summary: Spruce Biosciences, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) on April 20, 2026, for a proposed public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown under an existing shelf registration statement. Terms (price per share, offering size, discount) are left blank as preliminary. The filing is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation event. The company is raising funds via underwritten public offering; no special-situation attributes are present.
